quiz_q_identify_ext: Identify this fire extinguisher. What type of fire is it used for?
quiz_opt_class_a: Class A: ordinary combustibles like wood, paper and cloth
quiz_opt_class_bc: Class BC: flammable liquids and electrical fires
quiz_opt_class_abc: Class ABC: multipurpose, works on all three
quiz_exp_ext_grey: The GREY extinguisher is Class A: wood, paper and cloth. Never use it on liquid or electrical fires.
quiz_exp_ext_yellow: The YELLOW extinguisher is Class BC: flammable liquids and electrical fires.
quiz_exp_ext_red: The RED extinguisher is ABC multipurpose, the safest choice when a fire could spread across several materials.
quiz_q_trash: Paper in this trash can is on fire. Which extinguisher should you grab?
quiz_opt_let_burn: None. Let it burn out on its own
quiz_opt_carry_outside: None. Carry the burning bin outside
quiz_exp_trash: Burning paper is a Class A fire (ordinary combustibles), so the GREY Class A extinguisher is the one to grab.
quiz_q_appliance_not_use: A toaster and kettle caught fire at a plugged-in outlet. Which extinguisher must you NOT use?
quiz_opt_all_safe: None. They are all safe here
quiz_exp_appliance: This is an electrical (Class BC) fire. Using the GREY Class A extinguisher here is dangerous, not just ineffective.
quiz_q_furnace: The gas furnace is on fire. What must you do before putting the fire out?
quiz_opt_open_door: Open the furnace door to look inside
quiz_opt_spray_top: Spray at the top of the flames
quiz_opt_turn_up: Turn the furnace up to burn the fuel off
quiz_exp_furnace: Shut off the gas first. If the flames go out while gas keeps flowing, the gas builds up and can explode.
quiz_q_first_action: You discover a fire. What should you do FIRST?
quiz_opt_sound_alarm: Sound the alarm using the manual call point
quiz_opt_take_photo: Take a photo to report it later
quiz_exp_first_action: Raise the alarm first so everyone can get out and help is on the way.
quiz_q_pass: What does PASS stand for when using an extinguisher?
quiz_exp_pass: PASS: Pull the pin, Aim at the base, Squeeze the handle, Sweep side to side.
quiz_q_aim: Where should you aim the extinguisher?
quiz_opt_aim_base: At the base of the fire
quiz_opt_aim_top: At the top of the flames
quiz_exp_aim: Aim at the base, where the fuel is burning. Spraying the flames themselves does little.
quiz_q_distance: How close should you stand to the fire while using an extinguisher?
quiz_opt_dist_4ft: No closer than about 4 ft (1.2 m)
quiz_opt_dist_next: Right next to it so the spray is stronger
quiz_exp_distance: Stay at least 4 ft back. Getting closer risks burns and doesn't help put the fire out.
quiz_status_not_passed: Fire safety quiz not passed. No certificate. Retry the last scenario to take the quiz again.
quiz_m_q_estop: What is this red-and-yellow switch on the control box for?
quiz_m_opt_estop_emergency: Emergency stop: stops the belt instantly, in any mode
quiz_m_exp_estop: It's the E-STOP. It stops the belt immediately whatever mode it's in, and stays latched until you reset it.
quiz_m_q_caught: Someone's sleeve gets caught in the moving belt. What do you do first?
quiz_m_opt_caught_stop_wait: Tap STOP and wait for the belt to finish
quiz_m_opt_caught_pull: Pull the sleeve free while the belt runs
quiz_m_exp_caught: In an emergency, the E-STOP is the fastest way to stop the belt. Only then free the person.
quiz_m_q_after_estop: After an E-stop, how does the belt start again?
quiz_m_opt_after_reset_start: Reset the E-STOP, then press START (or jog) again
quiz_m_opt_after_auto: It restarts on its own once the E-STOP is reset
quiz_m_opt_after_manual: Switch to MANUAL, which overrides the E-STOP
quiz_m_exp_after_estop: Resetting the E-STOP never restarts the belt by itself. Someone has to press START or jog deliberately.
quiz_m_q_normal_stop: How should you stop the belt during normal work?
quiz_m_opt_normal_slow: Turn the speed dial to slow
quiz_m_exp_normal_stop: STOP is the normal way to stop the belt. Keep the E-STOP for emergencies.
quiz_m_q_manual: In MANUAL mode, when does the belt move?
quiz_m_opt_manual_hold: Only while you hold the green button
quiz_m_opt_manual_never: It can't move in MANUAL mode
quiz_m_exp_manual: MANUAL is for jogging. The belt only moves while the green button is held and stops as soon as you let go.
quiz_m_q_mode_switch: What happens if you switch between AUTO and MANUAL while the belt is running?
quiz_m_exp_mode_switch: Changing mode always stops the belt, so it's never left running unattended. Start it again in the new mode.
quiz_m_q_mode_estopped: The E-STOP is pressed. Can you switch between AUTO and MANUAL?
quiz_m_opt_estopped_running: Only while the belt is running
quiz_m_exp_mode_estopped: While the E-STOP is latched, the mode button does nothing. Deal with the fault and reset the E-STOP first.
quiz_m_q_hands: The belt is running. Where should your hands be?
quiz_m_opt_hands_clear: Clear of the belt, rollers and pinch points
quiz_m_opt_hands_guide: On the belt, guiding items along
quiz_m_opt_hands_rollers: On the rollers, feeling for problems
quiz_m_opt_hands_under: Under the belt, ready to catch items
quiz_m_exp_hands: Moving belts and rollers can pull in hands, sleeves and hair. Keep clear of them while the belt runs.
quiz_m_q_jam: A box is jammed on the belt. Before you reach in to clear it, you must:
quiz_m_opt_jam_stop_latch: Stop the belt and latch the E-STOP so it can't start
quiz_m_opt_jam_faster: Speed the belt up to push it through
quiz_m_opt_jam_jog: Switch to MANUAL and jog while pulling it out
quiz_m_exp_jam: Never reach into a conveyor that can move. Stop it and latch the E-STOP first.
quiz_m_q_before_start: Before starting the belt, what should you check?
quiz_m_opt_before_clear: That nobody is touching the belt and the area is clear
quiz_m_opt_before_fast: That the speed is set to fast
quiz_m_exp_before_start: Always make sure the area is clear before starting, so the belt can't catch anyone.
machine_task_run_auto: Tap the green START (I) button to run the belt in AUTO mode
machine_task_back_to_auto: Press the MANUAL/AUTO button to switch back to AUTO
machine_task_stop: Tap the red STOP (O) button to stop the belt
machine_task_estop: Tap the red-and-yellow E-STOP switch on the side of the control box
machine_task_reset: Tap the E-STOP again to reset it
machine_task_manual: Press the MANUAL/AUTO button to switch to MANUAL
machine_task_jog: Hold the green START (I) button to jog the belt
machine_task_speed: Tap the speed dial to change the belt speed
